connector.name: K Data MCP
connector.registryDescription: Korean market data for agents: tradeable-basis kimchi premium, history/percentiles, translated news.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package k-data-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the juh5ng account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: K_DATA_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key of a dedicated wallet holding USDC on Base. Each tool call spends from it. No ETH needed - x402 settles off-chain and the facilitator pays gas.

env.name: K_DATA_MAX_SPEND_USD
env.description: Hard cap on cumulative spend for the session. The server refuses any call that would exceed it.

env.name: K_DATA_BASE_URL
env.description: Point at a different K-Data deployment.
